title: The Name in Use
logline: People use different names for the same shared place or thing, and the names change what they do.
human_question: What changes in people's actions and relationships when the same part of their shared world carries different names?

premise.story: A practical need (finding the way, teaching, coordinating work) moves through a place that carries more than one name.
premise.place: A lived-in setting where more than one naming practice is genuinely used.
premise.experience: Listening closely to names spoken in context and watching the actions they prompt.

concept_links.why: Conventional wholes, names, spoken sound and assigned meaning, in real use.

what_camera_could_observe: A word spoken, written, pointed to, corrected or translated
The place or object seen from several distances
what_must_be_real: The terms actually used, by whom, in which situation. Checked with the people concerned.

possible_arc.opening: A name heard before its thing is seen.
possible_arc.turn: A second name for the same thing, and a different action follows.
possible_arc.ending_open: Whatever the research finds, including 'the names cause no difficulty'.

position_hint: flexible; recommend merging into IDEA-0001 (One Mountain, Many Names), its most concrete form

requirements: More than one naming practice genuinely in use

drop_if: Only interchangeable synonyms with no human consequence

connections.note: The pilot's premise, made concrete by the mountain.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
evidence_class_note: All content is editorial proposal. Location suggestions are AI suggestions only; selection belongs to Chathura.
